title: Jets will place franchise tag on running back Breece Hall

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets will place franchise tag on running back Breece Hall
sources.description: The Jets are going to use the franchise tag on Breece Hall per Connor Hughes. This is not a surprise. Jets general manager Darren Mougey said just a few days ago that the Jets would tag Hall if the team could not work out a long-term extension for the running back by today’s deadline. There […]
